title: Catchment and stream network of the Ikopa River above Antananarivo, Madagascar

headline.label: catchment of the Ikopa River above Antananarivo

data: NASADEM_HGT version 001 by NASA JPL (2020): 1 arc-second (about 30 m) elevations from the SRTM flight of 11 to 22 February 2000, reprocessed by NASA, in metres above the EGM96 geoid, tiles s20e048, s20e047, s19e048, s19e047.
method: Read a 86 × 112 km window and reprojected it to 60 m cells in EPSG:32738 by bilinear resampling.
Conditioned the terrain with priority-flood depression filling and derived D8 flow directions and upstream area (pyflwdir), with flow leaving at the window edge.

Placed the outlet on the Ikopa River at 47.4680, -18.8720 and moved it downstream to the first cell draining at least 500 km² (205 m), then delineated the catchment above it and checked that it does not touch the window edge.
Streams: every cell draining 5 km² or more, ordered by Strahler; drainage density recounted at 2.5 and 25 km² to show the effect of the threshold.
limits: Terrain analysis for a hydrology study, not a hydrology or flood study: no rainfall, runoff, discharge or flood level is computed. NASADEM records the surface of February 2000 with about 30 m cells; SRTM-based heights carry absolute errors of about 5 to 9 m (90% level, Rodríguez et al. 2006), more on steep slopes, and include tree canopy and buildings, so streams are least reliable in forest, in towns and on flat ground.
